The best answer is still **C (about 26,000)**. The Global Terrorism Index 2018 counted roughly 18,800 terrorism deaths in 2017, which is closer to 26,000 than to 2,600 on a log scale. The team note says 2,600 or 260, but those figures don't match the published data, so I'm not changing my answer.

CONFIDENCE: 72
